comment: The public roadmap. `bun nv site --check roadmap` keeps it in step with the goal chain, and `bun nv site --roadmap` copies it into README.md. `internal` lists the goals that are not public work.

themes.title: Scheduled jobs that run on server events
themes.text: A `[[schedule]]` entry can run its script when the server starts, stops or reloads. It can also run when a scheduled job or a queue job fails.
